Description: StillWatch single-zone Android application backend with authenticated worker actions, durable state and IoT telemetry ingestion.

must: Deploy only in the selected project Region ap-southeast-2.
Worker response and manager acknowledgement must remain separate.
No plaintext credentials in source or outputs.

FirebaseSecretName.Description: Optional existing Secrets Manager secret name holding Firebase service-account JSON; never provide its content.

OpenAiSecretArn.Description: Existing Secrets Manager ARN holding {apiKey}; never the secret value.

DeviceSecretArn.Description: Device MQTT secret ARN; never the credentials.
